name: Loan and Interest Settings in MifosX
description: Demonstration of declining balance, moratoriums, and prepayments.

steps.title: Configure Loan Principal
steps.details: Enter a principal amount of 10,000 with a 12% annual interest rate.

steps.title: Set Moratorium Period
steps.details: Apply a 3-month moratorium where no principal is repaid.

steps.title: Execute Prepayment
steps.details: Apply a $2,000 prepayment in Month 6 to recalculate interest savings.
